mainEntity.name: Is $299 the whole monthly price for the receptionist?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The 24/7 AI Receptionist is $299 a month flat, billed month to month, with 30 days written notice to cancel. Front Door and Front Door + Growth are separate services with their own monthly prices on the pricing page.

mainEntity.name: Does the price change with call volume?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a flat monthly price, not a per-minute or per-call rate. The bill is the same in a slow month and a busy one.
